people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

people.name: Hadad
people.line: The last king of Edom before Israelite rule.

people.name: Timna
people.line: Concubine of Eliphaz; mother of Amalek

translations.web: Then Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,
translations.bsb: Then Hadad died. Now the chiefs of Edom were Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
translations.kjv: Hadad died also. And the dukes of Edom were; duke Timnah, duke Aliah, duke Jetheth,
translations.asv: And Hadad died. And the chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,
